course.title: Material Handling and Maintenance Management
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A plant produces 75 units/hr of an item with dimensions of 0.5\*0.5\*0.l foot. The management wishes to ·store a I-week supply in containers measuring 7\*7\*4 feet. A minimum of 3 inches of space is required between adjacent units in each direction for packaging and handling. Determine the number of containers needed. If these containers can be staked two high, determine the floor space required.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
